text: Visiting the Dentist!
Mahino is a six-year-old girl. She is at the dentist today. We are interviewing her for Kids Magazine.
Do you like going to the dentist?
I like Dr. Alfi's office. It's colorful and everyone is really nice, too.
say: I like Doctor Alfee's office. It's colorful, and everyone is really nice, too.

text: Why are you at the dentist today?
I had an appointment to get my teeth cleaned.
Who helps you at the dentist's office?
A few people help me. First, the receptionist welcomes my mom and me with a big smile. She sits at the front desk and gets our names and some information.
Then, Hala, the woman who cleans my teeth, comes to get me. She is a hygienist. She takes me to the back.
say: Then, Hala, the woman who cleans my teeth, comes to get me. She is a hygienist. She takes me to the back.

text: Tell us more about how Hala helps you.
Hala has me sit in a chair and asks me to please sit still. Then, Hala takes x-rays of my teeth.
say: Hala has me sit in a chair, and asks me to please sit still. Then, Hala takes x-rays of my teeth.

text: An x-ray is a special kind of black and white picture that helps the dentist see my teeth better. It only takes a second, and you can't feel anything!
say: An x-ray is a special kind of black and white picture, that helps the dentist see my teeth better. It only takes a second, and you can't feel anything!

text: What happens next?
After the x-rays, I stay in the chair, and Hala hands me a pair of sunglasses. Then, I sit under a bright light while Hala uses a tiny mirror to look at my teeth.
Then, she cleans my teeth with a couple of different tools. When she is done, my teeth feel smooth.
Do you help Hala in any way?
Well, I try my best to sit still. I open my mouth wide and close my mouth when Hala asks me to.
I also raise my hand if something hurts or if I need to rest and close my mouth.
Does Hala do anything else?
She puts fluoride on my teeth. It's quick. Hala just brushes a sticky goo all over my teeth.
say: She puts flooride on my teeth. It's quick. Hala just brushes a sticky goo all over my teeth.

text: I get to pick the flavor, too! Of course, I always choose bubble gum. It tastes yummy!
What does fluoride do?
Fluoride helps keep the enamel on your teeth strong.
say: Flooride helps keep the enamel on your teeth strong.

text: Sticky stuff called plaque is made of germs and bacteria. It can form on your teeth, especially if you do not take care of them. If there is too much plaque, it can make a hole in your tooth!
say: Sticky stuff called plack is made of germs and bacteria. It can form on your teeth, especially if you do not take care of them. If there is too much plack, it can make a hole in your tooth!

text: Touch your teeth. Do you feel that smooth layer on your teeth? That pretty, white layer is called enamel. Enamel is the hardest thing in the human body. It is even harder than your bones!
When do you see the dentist?
Dr. Alfi comes in when Hala is finished.
say: Doctor Alfee comes in when Hala is finished.

text: What does Dr. Alfi do?
Dr. Alfi looks at my x-rays. He always tells me I'll be losing more baby teeth! Dr. Alfi says his son has already lost six baby teeth. He's my age, too!
say: Doctor Alfee looks at my x-rays. He always tells me I'll be losing more baby teeth! Doctor Alfee says his son has already lost six baby teeth. He's my age, too!

text: Thank you, Mahino!
Bye-bye! Take care of your teeth!
say: Bye bye! Take care of your teeth!

text: Let's think! What is an x-ray?
An x-ray is a special kind of black and white picture that helps the dentist see teeth better.
How does Hala help Mahino feel comfortable?
She gives Mahino sunglasses for the bright light, and lets her pick the flavor!
What is fluoride?
Fluoride is a sticky goo that helps keep the enamel on your teeth strong.
say: Flooride is a sticky goo that helps keep the enamel on your teeth strong.

text: Great job! The End.
